Coram : A.K. SIKRI*, ASHOK BHUSHAN
Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007: ss.30 and 31 – Court Martial proceedings – Charges pertained to the alleged obscene calls purportedly made by the respondent to the three ladies who were wives of three officers of navy – Finding of guilt – Dismissal from service as well months of seniority – Armed Force Tribunal (AFT) maintained the conviction on certain charges, however, found that punishment of dismissal from service was disproportionate to the nature of the charges – Aggrieved Union of India and the officer both appealed – Held: The
Decision Date : 18-04-2018 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 579/2016 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
